basis: coordinator verdicts after independent adversarial review (all headline numbers reproduced exactly)
note: No factor is LIVE_RESEARCH or prospectively validated. 2023-2025 holdout was previously inspected (exploratory). Status criteria were written after each workstream's holdout run (review finding 3); consumers/params were frozen before.

factors.name: Sportsbook game context (spread, total, implied team total)
factors.evidence: Historical lines are nflverse CLOSING lines (CLOSING_LINE_PROXY_RETROSPECTIVE); pass-yds gain over volume base -0.85 [-1.35,-0.29] cannot be credited to a pregame prediction. Live FanDuel lines captured for all 16 week-3 games. uses_market_input=True.
blockers: no historical timestamped pregame game lines

factors.name: Snap share, trends and role changes
factors.evidence: Small holdout gains, worse on FRESH_2026 in all three markets; only scenario 'backup RB rising while top RB OUT' is sharp (rushing -3.58 [-5.51,-1.83], n=55).

factors.name: Target share, air-yards share, aDOT, WOPR
factors.evidence: Historically supported, NOT prospectively validated, and NARROWED by independent review: the gain is target share x team targets with shrunk catch rate and yards/target. aDOT adds nothing (holdout diff ~0, CI spans 0); WOPR and air_yards_share are computed but unused. Beats zero-target-inclusive and team-volume mechanical controls (receptions -0.0071 [-0.0093,-0.0046]).

factors.name: Red-zone and goal-line opportunity
factors.evidence: Historically supported, NOT prospectively validated, narrow: only the volume_only comparison is informative (-0.00170 [-0.00212,-0.00131] log loss holdout; FRESH -0.0021, CI spans 0). The 'vs scale control' test was vacuous (B0 exactly 0 on ~36% of rows; fixed in harness). Gain ~4x larger on holdout than DEV; probabilities too flat by decile; 2+ TD research distribution underpredicts.

factors.name: Team pass rate over expected, neutral pass rate, pace
factors.evidence: PROE, neutral dropback rate, plays/game, sec/play add nothing measurable over the strictly-prior team-volume base (pass -0.085 [-0.205,+0.032]).

factors.name: Weather forecast, roof, surface
factors.evidence: receiving_yards ONLY: historically supported, NOT prospectively validated (gain over volume base -0.021 [-0.035,-0.008], z~3.1). passing_yards DOWNGRADED to BUILT by review (z~2.3, does not survive ~12 incremental tests; same team volume model, FRESH n=71). GFS MOS forecasts from IEM, run >=25.5h before kickoff for all 1,816 rows; observed game weather never used. Open-Meteo blocked (daily limit).
blockers: Sunday/Monday week-3 forecast runs not yet issued

factors.name: Rest, short week, bye, travel, time zone
factors.evidence: Rest, short week, bye, travel km, time zones, west-to-east early kickoff, international: no incremental value (pass +0.023 [-0.086,+0.126]).

factors.name: Official injury and practice reports
factors.evidence: REJECTED as a workload adjustment among players who played (no gain; receiving yards worse on FRESH). Its value as an availability forecast was never tested (review), so overall PARTIAL. Official inactives gate unchanged (fail-closed).
blockers: week-3 final reports: only ATL/GB filed

factors.name: Teammate-absence opportunity redistribution
factors.evidence: Receptions holdout -0.0035 [-0.0059,-0.0011] and FRESH -0.0039; rushing worse on FRESH (+0.122). Mass balance never over-allocates (cap 0.5; 36-39% of vacated budget unallocated).

factors.name: Opponent allowed-by-position and matchup context
factors.evidence: Passing yards meets the declared rule (holdout -0.421 [-0.754,-0.097], FRESH -0.05) but WS-C applied a stricter local DEV-CI rule; kept BUILT conservatively. Receptions worse on FRESH. Allowed-by-position only; not WR-vs-CB, no slot/wide split.
